title: Kadana
desc: When Amar, an army officer, discovers that his wife and a reporter have been tortured by a corrupt politician and criminal duo, he resolves to fight them.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.

title: Kishkindhapuri
desc: The guests visit a vintage radio station for a ghost tour where they awaken a slumbering spirit. Locked inside, they struggle to escape as otherworldly powers endanger their existence.

title: O Premave
desc: Raja, a young man, crosses paths with Prema and falls in love with her. However, their union is opposed by her father, who wishes her to get married to a man of his choice.

title: Landlord
desc: In a 1980s rural community the headstrong village chief dismisses formal education and brazenly flouts the law to impose his will on the populace.

title: Rider
desc: As love blossoms between orphans Chinnu and Kitty, fate separates them as children. However, they grow up yearning to find each other.
